claims: There was a DHS government shutdown in March 2026.
Roughly 60,000 TSA employees were required to work without pay during the March 2026 DHS government shutdown.
Hundreds of TSA employees quit during the March 2026 DHS government shutdown.
Thousands of daily call-outs occurred among TSA employees during the March 2026 DHS government shutdown.
On March 27, 2026, President Trump signed an order to pay TSA employees using alternative funds.
Nearly 500 transportation security officers quit in March 2026.
Call-out rates reached 11% nationwide in March 2026.
Long wait times exceeding three hours occurred at some airports in March 2026.
TSA workers missed three paychecks before the order to pay them was signed.
The Acting TSA Administrator reported that workers faced financial ruin, including selling plasma and sleeping in cars to stay on the job.
President Trump's order redirects funds with a "reasonable and logical nexus" to TSA operations to pay employees.
ICE agents were deployed to airports to assist with staffing shortages.
TSA employees are slated to be paid under the executive order.
